sources.title: Q1 FY2027 management call, August 13, 2026
sources.locator: Call August 13, 2026; accessed September 28, 2026 (conservative availability, not asserted original filing date). Printed pp.14-16,19,23: revenue guidance, margin definition, working capital and asset-light operations.

rationale.revenue_growth: FY2027 base 17.5% and upside 20% within management 15-20% guidance; downside 12% is analyst stress. All later growth paths are analyst fade assumptions, not guidance or consensus.
rationale.ebit_margin: Management FY2027 EBITDA guidance 13-14% includes operational FX. FY2027 assumed management EBITDA: downside 12%, base 13.5%, upside 14%. Subtract FY2026 bank charges/revenue (499/39442) and historical D&A/revenue to obtain FCFF EBIT. Bank charges treated as operating; borrowing interest excluded. Subsequent margin paths are analyst estimates. Historical SQL EBIT excludes FX and adds back all finance costs; do not directly equate the two definitions.
rationale.depreciation_pct_revenue: Historical pooled FY2024-26 D&A / revenue = 205/100946. History is sourced in the SQL export.
rationale.capex_pct_revenue: Historical pooled cash PPE/intangible purchases / revenue = 216/100946; downside 1.5x, base 1x, upside 1x. Asset-light guidance supports low physical capex, not zero capex. No verified consensus capex series used.
rationale.nwc_pct_revenue: Opening trade/contract proxy 16094 = inventory358 + current receivables25236 + noncurrent receivables6481 + other current assets13949 - current trade payables714-11908 - noncurrent trade payables1892 - other current liabilities13342 - other noncurrent liabilities2074. Excludes cash, financial investments, loans, provisions and tax liabilities. Proxy is broader than management working-capital-days KPI; avoid substituting management days without reconciliation. Base/upside retain FY2026 ratio; downside increases by 3 percentage points.
rationale.tax_rate: 25% normalized analyst assumption, informed by FY2024-26 effective tax near 24%; not a marginal statutory-rate claim.
rationale.wacc_inputs: Illustrative CAPM calibration, not verified current market inputs or consensus WACC: risk-free6.5%, beta1, ERP6%, target debt weight5%. Pre-tax debt cost230/average debt(3617,2284), excluding bank charges. Downside beta1.2; upside0.9. Refresh risk-free/beta/ERP/market-value weights before an investment decision.
rationale.bridge: Cash and lease-inclusive debt come from SQL. 721 nonoperating assets = 669 equity-accounted investments +52 other investments, book-value proxies. Minority value52 uses book equity proxy, not fair value. Other claims0 is explicit analyst assumption, not a verified absence of all contingent claims. All reported cash assumed available; operational/restricted cash review remains needed. Shares63.150829m = FY2026 ending62.309595m + incremental diluted EPS options0.841234m; this is a dilution proxy, not an exact current-date treasury-stock calculation.
rationale.dates: Discount periods begin at FY2026 year-end with full FY2027 first forecast. Uses later report/guidance and analyst assumptions. Not a contemporaneous March2026 valuation, September2026 target, quarterly roll-forward or backtest.
rationale.consensus: No verified multi-broker consensus dataset available in this build. Management guidance is used where verified; remaining operational drivers use historical ratios with explicit analyst scenarios. Discount/terminal assumptions remain analyst inputs.
rationale.terminal: Explicit-year FCFF uses operating reinvestment. Terminal FCFF = next-year NOPAT * (1-g/ROIC), with stable margin and a separately stated terminal ROIC. This avoids perpetuating final high-growth working-capital investment. Transition is simplified and should be reviewed.
